title: How UCP composes with the other protocols
caption: Solid lines are documented links: AP2 as an optional extension, MCP and A2A as transports, Web Bot Auth as optional signature interop. Dotted lines are overlaps without a specified bridge. Copilot Checkout requires a UCP-compliant feed, and Microsoft says its Merchant Center will support UCP.
alt: Flowchart centered on UCP. AP2 mandates plug in as the optional ap2_mandate extension. MCP and A2A are transports. Web Bot Auth is an optional signature interop. Dotted, undocumented overlaps: Mastercard Agent Pay tokens could fit the network_token credential type; Visa TAP also uses RFC 9421 but has no bridge; OpenAI ACP does the same job with no bridge; x402 is not mentioned in the spec; ERC-8004 is not mentioned and UCP identity is domain-based. UCP powers checkout in Google AI Mode, Gemini and Universal Cart, and Microsoft Copilot Checkout requires a UCP-compliant feed.
